pictures.name: clear_spring_water_in_a_channel
pictures.scene: perfectly clear water running through a clean stone channel with the gravel bright beneath it, the water lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the bank and air above it green and dim and quiet

pictures.name: well_kept_boundary_wall
pictures.scene: a dry stone field wall built close and sound with every stone still in its place, the nearest course lit warm and hard along the bottom of the frame, the pasture and sky above it soft and pale and open

pictures.name: single_track_across_open_moor
pictures.scene: one narrow footpath holding its line straight across a wide featureless moor, the near track lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the empty ground and sky above it grey and flat and vast

pictures.name: treasure_buried_in_a_field
pictures.scene: a small hollow opened in a ploughed field showing gold buried down in the dark soil, the buried gold lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the field above and around it brown and quiet

pictures.name: sunlight_filling_an_open_court
pictures.scene: a swept stone courtyard filled corner to corner with clean bright sunlight, the near paving lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the plain walls above it pale and even and untroubled

pictures.name: spring_bubbling_up_out_of_rock
pictures.scene: a strong spring welling up out of a crack in bare rock and spilling away downhill, the rising water lit warm and bright low in the frame, the rock wall above it dim and wet and standing quiet

pictures.name: heap_of_gold_and_gems_on_cloth
pictures.scene: a small heap of gold pieces and cut stones poured out together on a dark cloth, the treasure lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the cloth and the room above it deep and dim and still

pictures.name: still_pool_reflecting_the_sky
pictures.scene: a small pool lying so still that it gives the whole sky back unbroken, the near reeds and rim lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the reflected sky above them pale and deep and motionless

pictures.name: honeycomb_on_a_wooden_board
pictures.scene: a thick piece of golden honeycomb set out dripping on a plain wooden board, the comb lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the table and the room above it brown and dim and quiet

lines.text: How can a young man keep his way pure?
By guarding it according to Your word.
With all my heart I have sought You;
do not let me stray from Your commandments.
I have hidden Your word in my heart
that I might not sin against You.
all the judgments of Your mouth.
I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies
as much as in all riches.
I will meditate on Your precepts
I will delight in Your statutes;
I will not forget Your word.
